description: Adversaries may search network shares on computers they have compromised to find files of interest. Sensitive data can be collected from remote systems via shared network drives (host shared directory, network file server, etc.) that are accessible from the current system prior to Exfiltration. Interactive command shells may be in use, and common functionality within cmd may be used to gather information.
artifacts: SMB NetShareEnum / NetShareEnumAll requests to enumerate available shares
SMB Tree Connect requests to shares (e.g. C$, ADMIN$, IT, custom shares)
SMB2 CREATE / READ operations on files within accessed shares
NTLM or Kerberos authentication to SMB server
SMB file download traffic (GET operations) towards the client
access denied responses on restricted shares (STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED)
authenticated access with domain or local credentials
